_note: Who is in the first room, and where. Read by the game (to find each character in
the room scene and give the dialogue their name and colour) and by
tools/build_cabin.gd (to place them when a room is first built).
`assets` is the folder under art/characters and the key in the speech data. It is
NOT the same as `id`: the id is what the screenplay calls them, which is short
because a writer types it a thousand times. Keeping both means a character can be
renamed in the script without moving any files.
`at` only decides where a character is the first time a room is built. After that
the room scene holds the position and the owner moves them by dragging.
